violations.text: Frozen fish was observed thawing in stagnant water. Fish was brought to walk-in and/or began to process out of packaging. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/10/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. PIC stated a food safety manager is to be transferred from another location. New Violation. Correct By: 09/10/2026

An employee was observed touching ready to eat food (lemon wedges) with bare hands. Food employees must not touch exposed, ready-to-eat food with their bare hands and shall use suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, single use gloves, or dispensing equipment. Staff were instructed to wear gloves. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2026

Several foods were observed held at 47-48 degrees Fahrenheit in the cold drawers; clamcake batter was observed held at 45 degrees on the counter. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Clam cake batter was disposed; ice was obtained to facilitate cold holding in the drawers. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2026
Water received from a hose connected to an adjacent building is not approved for use. New Violation. Correct By: 09/24/2026
Sugar was observed stored on the floor in the outdoor storage shed. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 09/10/2026

The prep unit and cold drawers were observed in poor repair, with ambient temperatures of 51- and 50-degrees F. A leak was observed at the fan box of the walk-in cooler.PIC called for service. Ice was obtained to temporarily facilitate cold holding temperatures. New Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2026
